variant_name.meaning: the agreement tier, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement (basis defined in the account charter lifecycle)

start_date.meaning: first day of the current term; empty until activated

term_end_date.meaning: last day of the current term; empty until activated

auto_renew.meaning: whether the agreement renews at term end unless non-renewal notice is given

sites_covered.meaning: number of properties on the covered-property list

suspended_date.meaning: date of the most recent suspension; empty if never suspended

expired_date.meaning: date the agreement expired; empty otherwise

cancelled_date.meaning: date the agreement or enrollment was cancelled; empty otherwise

agreement_balance.meaning: current amount owed on the agreement: charges and refunds less payments and credits

account_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the agreement charge

customer_id.meaning: customer holding the agreement (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: charge family, taken verbatim from the account charter event types

term_start_date.meaning: first day of the agreement term the charge belongs to

service_date.meaning: date a survey or training session was delivered or a change made; empty otherwise

fee_period.meaning: monthly fee period of a late fee; empty otherwise

posted_date.meaning: date the charge posted; the charge is due the tier's payment terms days later

source_payment_id.meaning: card payment a surcharge was assessed on (foreign key -> account_payments); empty otherwise

account_payment_id.meaning: primary id of the payment, credit or refund line

agreement_id.meaning: agreement the line belongs to (foreign key -> account_agreements)

customer_id.meaning: customer holding the agreement (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: payment family, taken verbatim from the account charter event types

payment_method.meaning: tender of a payment or refund

payment_reference.meaning: check, wire or confirmation number exactly as printed

related_job_id.meaning: the water or fire job whose late arrival an SLA credit compensates (its reference number); empty otherwise

term_start_date.meaning: first day of the term a rebate or proration credit belongs to; empty otherwise

source_payment_id.meaning: payment a refund returns money from (foreign key -> account_payments); empty otherwise

amount.meaning: amount of the line, positive; direction follows from the event type

account_referral_id.meaning: primary id of the carrier referral

agreement_id.meaning: carrier agreement the referral was made under (foreign key -> account_agreements)

customer_id.meaning: carrier customer that made the referral (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: referral family, taken verbatim from the account charter event types

referral_number.meaning: carrier's referral (assignment) number exactly as sent

contacted_within_commitment.meaning: whether the insured was contacted within the contact commitment
